connector.name: Signupgenius MCP
connector.registryDescription: SignUpGenius for Claude - sign-ups, slot reports, and groups. Free accounts or Pro API key.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package signupgenius-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the chrischall account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SIGNUPGENIUS_EMAIL
env.description: SignUpGenius login email (recommended). Pair with SIGNUPGENIUS_PASSWORD for session mode — works on free accounts. No SSO/2FA.

env.name: SIGNUPGENIUS_PASSWORD
env.description: SignUpGenius password (recommended) — required iff SIGNUPGENIUS_EMAIL is set.

env.name: SIGNUPGENIUS_USER_KEY
env.description: SignUpGenius Pro API key (Pro Tools > API Management). Required only for slot REPORTS — Pro subscription needed.

env.name: SIGNUPGENIUS_NAME
env.description: Friendly account name used in startup logs.

env.name: SIGNUPGENIUS_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the default JSON API base (v2/k for key mode, v3 for session mode).

env.name: SIGNUPGENIUS_LEGACY_BASE_URL
env.description: Session mode only: override the host for legacy /SUGboxAPI.cfm calls. Defaults to https://www.signupgenius.com.

env.name: SIGNUPGENIUS_LOGIN_URL
env.description: Session mode only: override the login-form host. Defaults to https://www.signupgenius.com.

env.name: SIGNUPGENIUS_DISABLE_FETCHPROXY
env.description: Set to 1 to skip the fetchproxy browser-extension fallback (missing creds become a hard error — useful in headless CI).
